name: Ling Yue Services Group Limited
summary: Ling Yue Services Group Limited, established in 2002 and based in Chengdu, provides property management in China, including security, upkeep, landscaping and maintenance for owners, residents, developers and non-residential tenants. It manages residential, commercial and public properties and offers value-added services such as sales office operations, pre-occupancy support, interior decoration and community retail.
